items.title: Tom Albert and Milton "Mooney" Martin Interview, 1964-12-21
items.q: In my time on Tash Street, you take, you take, I used to play as you there, Chook.

ctx.x: Do you remember any others? Was Buddy Johnson the barber? Yeah. That's what I thought.
That's where all them fellas, I can call them all almost. In my time on Tash Street, you take, you take, I used to play as you there, Chook. Chook, yeah.
Chook? Chook. Chook. That's what his name is, Chook. I don't know what his name is.
